name: convokraft-agent-success
purpose: Check agent decisions when building or diagnosing Catalyst convokraft workflows.

cases.title: Publish action changes
cases.prompt: I changed a ConvoKraft action, trained it, and deployed its Node.js function. Development works; the production bot still answers using the old action. Explain the next step.
expected_behavior: Checks the bot's production action release and selected changed actions.
Distinguishes backend deployment from action publication.
failure_behavior: Claims training alone publishes the action.
cases.pass_signal: Agent identifies the bot's Deploy to Production action selection.

cases.title: Webhook timeout differs from Integration
cases.prompt: My ConvoKraft external webhook returns HTTP 200 with a small JSON reply after eight seconds, but the bot shows a failure. I thought the limit was fifteen seconds.
expected_behavior: Identifies the 5-second webhook timeout versus the 15-second Integration Function timeout.
Suggests shorter synchronous work or an honest acknowledgement and status action.
failure_behavior: Applies Integration Function limits to the webhook.
Invents a setting to increase the platform timeout.
cases.pass_signal: Agent correctly distinguishes the two backend limits.

cases.title: Async Integration dispatcher
cases.prompt: In the generated ConvoKraft ES-module entry point I use jsonResponse = handleExecute(request), then response.end(new IntegResponse(jsonResponse)). I changed handleExecute to async and now the bot receives {}. Fix the response flow.
expected_behavior: Awaits handleExecute inside the dispatcher's try block.
Preserves IntegResponse and the existing dispatch for other handlers.
failure_behavior: Replaces the transport with Express res.json.
cases.pass_signal: Agent awaits the async handler before wrapping the response.

cases.title: Differentiate intent and backend failures
cases.prompt: My ConvoKraft bot has two problems: unrelated questions are misunderstood, and a recognized action sometimes throws an exception. Which handlers and tests should I use?
expected_behavior: Uses fallback for unrecognized input and failure for exceptions.
Tests action recognition separately from backend execution.
failure_behavior: Routes both failures only to fallback.
Retrains the bot to fix all backend exceptions.
cases.pass_signal: Agent separates fallback and failure behavior.

cases.title: Widget loading order
cases.prompt: The ConvoKraft SDK script runs in the head before convokraft-chat-bot is inserted. The widget is blank, although my backend succeeds. How should I diagnose the embed?
expected_behavior: Checks the generated Clients setup, namespace, and target environment.
Loads the SDK after the bot element and inspects network/DOM evidence.
failure_behavior: Invents a standalone browser initialization API.
cases.pass_signal: Agent prioritizes the documented script order and client configuration.
